title: PCR
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs a PCR plating and PCR reaction on the Opentrons Thermocycler Module. The worklist input for where to transfer oligos should be specified in the following format, **including header line**: ``` Pipettor,Slot 5 well (Oligo source plate),Slot 10 well (Destination plate),Volume uL P20 single channel,A6,A1,10 P20 single channel,C1,A1,10 P20 single channel,A1,B1,10 P20 single channel,A7,B1,2.5 P20 single channel,A8,B1,2.5 P20 single channel,A9,B1,2.5 ... ``` You can download a template .csv file [here](https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/0aa51a/ex.csv).
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create worklist CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that lists each pipetting transfer for the Opentrons protocol. Include the header line exactly as shown: "Pipettor,Slot 5 well (Oligo source plate),Slot 10 well (Destination plate),Volume uL". Add rows for each transfer, for example: "P20 single channel,A6,A1,10", "P20 single channel,C1,A1,10", "P20 single channel,A1,B1,10", "P20 single channel,A7,B1,2.5", "P20 single channel,A8,B1,2.5", "P20 single channel,A9,B1,2.5", … . Download the template CSV from the provided link if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol interface, input the required protocol parameters (e.g., pipette type, deck slots, volumes) as prompted, using the values defined in your worklist CSV.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the source location and unzip the archive if it contains multiple files.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any custom labware JSON files required for the experiment.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, open the Protocol tab and upload the protocol Python file (.py) that will run the PCR plating and reaction.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck on the robot according to the provided deck map, placing the source plate in Slot 5, the destination plate in Slot 10, and any tip racks or other labware in their specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the pipette (P20 single‑channel) following the standard calibration workflow. Refer to the support articles for calibration tip usage if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the "Run" button in the Opentrons App to start the PCR plating and thermocycling sequence.
